meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 把 Linear 评论通道接进项目,之后代理会回复所选团队工单上的每条新评论,不用 @ 它;每条工单的评论串各自成一个独立会话。
howto.when: 在你要求给项目接入 Linear 时开始执行;配置完成并运行后,所选团队工单上任意新评论都会触发代理,无需 @ 它。使用个人 API 密钥时,自己账号的评论会被过滤。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目接入 Linear,让工单评论串变成会话。
say.note: 开始执行适配器接入和接线配置。

say.text: 接入时用 OAuth 应用身份,别用我个人账号发评论。
say.note: 这是推荐方式,代理不会把自己发的评论当自消息滤掉。

say.text: 把 ENG 团队接到对应代理,发送策略设为 strict。
say.note: strict 表示只有已登记成员能跟代理说话。

howto.what_en: Adds the Linear comment channel to the project. The agent replies to every new comment on issues in the selected team; no @ mention is needed. Each issue thread is its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Use it when the user asks to add Linear to the project. After setup and restart, any new comment on an issue in the selected team triggers the agent without an @; in personal API key mode, comments from that account are filtered.

say_en.text: Connect this project to Linear so issue threads become conversations.
say_en.note: Runs the adapter and wiring steps.

say_en.text: Set up Linear with an OAuth app, not with my personal account.
say_en.note: Recommended way to avoid self-message filtering.

say_en.text: Wire the ENG team to the chosen agent with the strict sender policy.
say_en.note: Strict means only registered members can talk to the agent.
